Phase-one evidence and gate status — 2026-11-18

Real Athena Obsidian acceptance run 21 passed: 89 mandatory assertions passed, 0 failed, with the 2 phase-two assertions skipped as out of this phase scope. Run report artifact: file:explicit:bed2e0d97ccd3a2624288065. The six visually inspected screenshot artifacts are: frontmatter-only reading file:explicit:769e949c1dbb69085e10b4c5; live dark wide file:explicit:2d289bd2417cd27d4dd5c48c; folded properties open file:explicit:09ac8f1ecf45e0f8ddb8b199; live light 375px file:explicit:a95227eb6d04ff49fc29fa6a; collapsed file:explicit:c57752fb786326f0222d5286; live light wide file:explicit:e28e8d1413ec5b4b13bfb89e. Deployed-vault startup smoke report artifact: file:explicit:36bbab23c7b6af310f23ac9e.

Record Card focused tests passed 94/94. Plugin build and build:check passed. Validate passed with all 11 manifests valid; docs inventory passed; docs:check passed, including 447 documentation tests and 1 expected dependency/font skip. Obsidian startup smoke unit tests passed 17/17; smoke help passed. Real pre-sync smoke passed. Post-sync deployed-vault smoke passed against /home/bryan/bob: layout-ready 365 ms, heap peak 46.8 MiB, all 4 editor cases passed, 0 exceptions, 0 rejections, and 0 crash artifacts. The no-force sync followed the deployment runbook after the protection refusal: fetched, fast-forwarded the landed commit 21cf4f9, cleaned and rebuilt, restored the phase changes, previewed, then synced without force. Post-sync dry run reported all 11 plugins up to date. bob plugins list still reports the known bob-emoji vault Git tracking warning.

The full plugin npm test gate is not green. It exited 1 with 7,309 passing, 4 failing, and 3 skipped unit tests; the 5-test perf suite passed. The four failures were 25 ms performance budgets in event-link-times, frees-marks, keep-moving-marks-surface, and off-clock-link-chips. The same four files passed when rerun serially: 110/110. This does not change the failed full npm test result.

sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-ms.8.3.1.1 passed with no entries. The requested bob-cli just check has not yet completed and will be staged through sase monitor. Because the full plugin npm test gate failed and just check is pending, this phase remains in_progress and is not being closed. bob-cli-ms.8.3.1.2 remains in_progress and unchanged.

2026-11-18 gate update: the repaired bob-cli `just check` passed; all 7,361 Rust tests and the rest of the recipe completed successfully. The required full bob-plugins `npm test` rerun remains red (monitor h1rzdhqtpazc, ToolRun 011dbb7aa779f859f49fc0963defa96a; diagnostic-manifest and retained-log refs attached above). `test:unit` reported 7,309 pass, 4 fail, 3 skipped; its separate `test:perf` suite passed 5/5. Exact failed wall-clock assertions: event-link-times 104.1 ms against 25 ms; frees-marks 174 ms against 25 ms; keep-moving-marks-surface 2,803.2 ms against its 250 ms assertion; off-clock-link-chips 164.5 ms against 35 ms. The `test:unit` script invokes `node --test` without an explicit file-concurrency limit. The prior serial rerun of these four files passed 110/110, so runner contention is plausible, though the measurements do not prove the cause. No code change was made. Because the required full plugin gate failed, this phase remains in_progress; bob-cli-ms.8.3.1.2 remains in_progress.

payload.entry: 2026-11-18 screencast repair: earlier sheet/CDP work is landed in bob-plugins 8e8ff51; integrated subsequent record-walk commit 281ee8a rather than rebuilding it. New explicit user requirement overrides the earlier whole-Properties hide: only title plus album-schema rows represented by the record card hide; parent/type/created, legacy/unknown keys and Add property remain native. Added bounded native-row ownership and a DOM replacement/key-change observer with cleanup on gate loss, view destruction and disable. Added regression tests and per-key CDP checks, including file/mode/type/parent return and a real tab-header click. Bumped ledger-tools to 1.136.0, regenerated bundle/inventory; bundle byte comparison after upstream integration matches fragments exactly. node --test scripts/test-ledger-tools-record-sheet.cjs scripts/test-obsidian-record-card-e2e.cjs scripts/test-ledger-tools-record-walk.cjs passes 40/40. No memory files changed. No epic-symbol entries. Remaining work is bounded verification/deployment, not another implementation epic: .build/property-hiding/verify.py runs full plugin gates, clean-base comparison on npm failure, current bob just check/build, isolated Athena proof/startup smoke, and non-force sync plus deployed-vault smoke only after required evidence passes. Outputs go to .build/property-hiding/verification/summary.json and results/. A monitor successor must inspect every screenshot, register audited artifacts, fix any introduced failures, and close only this bead. Known parent-listed timing failures must not strand this phase again; compare baseline evidence and honor the user closure instruction. Phase two and ancestor beads remain unchanged.
